scope: Bounded source-access discovery for post-final-bound captured FOR starts

contracts.capture: Select the counter reference before the initializer and preserve that storage when selectors change
contracts.order: Assign the initial value, evaluate the final bound once, then read the current captured counter as iterator start
contracts.effects: Internal globals and matching typed references may change the start; grouped or converted private arguments do not copy back
contracts.ranges: Proven inclusive TO/DOWNTO ranges retain existing bounded analysis; proven empty bodies contribute no inputs
contracts.unknown: Unknown but initialized starts widen conditionally; unproven initialized starts report for-start without inventing seedable counter inputs
contracts.unwinding: Existing cleanup and return-value capture remain unchanged; paused/external effects stay explicit analysis gaps
contracts.persistence: Existing source contracts, report/template/run formats and emitted runtime behavior remain unchanged
contracts.boundary: Static source-access coverage only; no runtime readiness or native/compiler/controller equivalence claim
